reason: Issue #308 (RFC 0031, Unresolved question 5, answered): the staged draft schema's pack-version and decimal-operand patterns each gain a not that refuses U+0000-U+001F, U+007F-U+009F and U+2028-U+202E, so neither admits a trailing line terminator in any engine RFC 0031 section 1.7 lists and both admit what the 0.3.0 patterns admit under ECMA-262. Staged draft only; the released 0.3.0 schema is unchanged.
